policy: task-first human product language; preserve established technical nouns only when they improve comprehension; Persian sentences must explain user intent, state and next action rather than mirror English implementation terminology
forbiddenRoboticPhrases: مرجع چرخه عمر نود وجود ندارد
درخواست موجود چرخه عمر نود Provider دوباره استفاده شد
Credential خام را اینجا قرار ندهید
هر مرحله قابل Resume و وابسته به Health است
این کارت‌ها از شواهد واقعی Runtime نصب‌کننده می‌آیند، نه Metric ساختگی
principles: lead with the user's task or state, not internal authority names
keep technical product nouns such as Kubernetes, RKE2, MCP and OIDC when they are the clearest established term
translate verbs and explanatory prose into natural Persian instead of mixing English grammar into Persian sentences
blocked/error copy must explain what is missing and what the user can do next
normal users never need OAuth scope strings, tool names, revision internals or implementation-layer vocabulary
apply the pinned persian-writing orthography and register rules to user-facing Persian copy
Latin protocol/product identifiers may remain; English grammar/adjectives inside Persian prose fail the release gate
